:*G2 > G3: 1500
:*G3 > G4: 2000
:*G4 > G5: 2500
:*G5 > G6: 3000
:*G6 > G7: 3500
:*G7 > G8: 4000

*Can be read every 8 to 12 hours.
*While in cooldown, you cannot use {{Ti|Soul Stone+}} or {{Ti|Talent Potion}}.
